MW_GAMES_entry.name: Panelysis
MW_GAMES_entry.tagline: One patient. One blood panel. Name the diagnosis in three tries.
MW_GAMES_entry.quip: Reference ranges are a guide. Your answer is not.
MW_GAMES_entry.helpQuip: Every wrong pick earns a hint. And a raised eyebrow.
help: Read the patient’s story and their blood results. H is high, L is low, * is abnormal.
Pick the diagnosis from six options. You get three tries.
Each wrong pick reveals a hint and highlights the results that matter.
When you finish, see why: the clinching values and a teaching pearl.
Difficulty rises through the week: Easy Mon-Tue, Medium Wed-Thu, Hard Fri-Sat, Genius Sun.
A new panel arrives at midnight, Sydney time. Past panels live in the archive.

panelysis: Panelysis is a daily blood test puzzle. Each day you get a fictional patient and their results: blood counts, electrolytes, liver, thyroid, iron, blood gases and more. Read the panel and pick the diagnosis in three tries; every wrong pick reveals a hint.
Doctors, nurses, students and anyone learning to read blood results. Easy days are gentle; Genius days hide subtle patterns.
They are typical Australian adult ranges. Every lab differs slightly, so always use the range printed on a real report.
